profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I have served as lead developer, engineering manager, project manager, and product manager on a suite of enterprise products, and worked alongside some of the top companies in the SaaS industry. I have a passion for software design and development, a history of demonstrating both the technical skills to design and produce customer-centric applications, and the people skills to build, scale and focus teams to accomplish great things.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: NoSQL · DynamoDB · Go · Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
In this role, I led the development of location resolution for Amazon Alexa's in-vehicle navigation capabilities.
My responsibilities included creating comprehensive benchmarking and analysis tools, identifying and addressing high-impact failure points, developing improvements, and measuring impact through experimentation and monitoring.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · AWS Lambda · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Large Language Models (LLM) · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Java · Spring Framework · Elasticsearch · Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Speech Recognition · Machine Learning · Geographic Information Systems (GIS) · CloudWatch · Optimization

positions.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering
positions.description:
In this role, I led development for multiple teams of engineers across product lines, including Zuora CPQ, third-party integration strategies and various services. 
Responsibilities of this role include ownership of architecture decisions, hands-on design and development, growth and mentorship of multiple teams of software engineers, and cross-functional collaboration to validate product direction.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: In this role, I led the team of engineers for the Zuora CPQ product line. Among my accomplishments in this role has been the design and implementation of Product-wide scalable API used to increase potential quoting volume by magnitudes, resulting in a 90% performance improvement in time and memory use.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: In this role, I served as a technical lead for the Zuora CPQ product line. Among my accomplishments in this role was the design and development of a dynamic, configurable rules engine, which has been used to extend the product to solve for countless Sales-based customer requirements through declarative configuration.

positions.title: Lead Technical Consultant
positions.description: In this role, I oversee all technical deliverables produced by the Zuora professional services team for North American West and APAC accounts, as well as several department-wide practice development areas.

positions.title: Senior Solutions Consultant
positions.description:
In this role, I lead development for large customer and internal projects, and manage a small team of consultants.

Responsibilities include:
- Development and technical leadership of internal utilities used across the organization
- Mentorship and management of new Solution Consultants
- Acted as project manager to successfully lead multiple emerging market customers to go live
- Ensuring delivery quality through solution design and code reviews
- Working cross-functionally to assist sales, support and engineering teams
- Working with customers to ensure complex requirements can be achieved, while following best practice

positions.title: Solutions Consultant
positions.description:
I joined Zuora as one of the first technical Solution Consultants in the Professional Services team. In this role, I designed and delivered integration solutions, and worked with clients to ensure successful go lives.

Responsibilities include:
- Acting as technical lead in client engagements
- Demonstrating subscription best practice and Zuora platform expertise
- Demonstrating Force.com platform expertise
- Requirement gathering and solution design
- Application and web development with various technologies
- Participation in cross-functional initiatives
- Design, development and management of the first company-endorsed Zuora-integrated eCommerce reference implementation

positions.title: Web Developer / Flash Developer
positions.description:
In this role, I worked with a team of peers from various artistic backgrounds to develop a website and series of Flash applications designed to teach fundamental chemistry to college students, and track progress for instructors.

Responsibilities included full ownership of technical architecture, including website development, Flash application development, and database development and administration.
